Tomo Mortgage · April 2026 to Present

Loan Processing Tools

Five tools I built and designed to help my team keep a pipeline of more than 100 loans moving.

Google Apps Script · Workflow Automation · AI Tools
Skills

The problem

With over 100 loans in my pipeline, email was the bottleneck. Every incoming message had to be matched to the right loan and filed by hand, and the status of each file lived in too many places.

The five tools

  1. Automatic email filing. A Google Apps Script that reads our pipeline sheet and labels each incoming email with the loan it belongs to, so it lands in the right place on its own.
  2. Shared pipeline tracker. One sheet the whole team uses to see the key milestones for every loan and where each file stands.
  3. Title order bot. A Gemini Gem that takes over the repetitive data entry for title orders.
  4. Parties screen bot. A second Gemini Gem that fills in the parties screen for each loan.
  5. Pipeline & inbox UX proposals. Designs for a clearer pipeline view and a loan inbox built into our platform.

The result

Less time sorting email and retyping the same information, and a single place where the team can check on any loan.

This work is covered by an NDA, so screenshots and some details are left out.

NYU Libraries · June 2025

Feather

A lightweight HR automation tool that drafts graduate student appointment letters about 5× faster.

Product Design · Python Development
Skills

The problem

As an HR student assistant at NYU Libraries, I saw how much time went into drafting graduate student appointment letters by hand: pulling names from a spreadsheet, checking each student's paperwork, and looking up mailing addresses in Workday, one letter at a time.

What I built

Feather turns that into one guided workflow:

  1. Import the appointment board. Upload the spreadsheet exported from monday.com as is. Feather picks out every student who hasn't received a welcome email yet.
  2. Choose the students and semester for the batch.
  3. Scan their forms. Feather reads each student's form with OCR, checks that the start date is valid for the semester, and pulls the mailing address into the letter, so nobody has to look it up.
  4. Add job descriptions with one-click copy buttons for each job title.
  5. Generate and review. Feather creates a PDF letter for every student and walks through each one in a built-in viewer for approval or edits.

Everything runs locally on the user's computer, and no data is sent over the internet.

The result

Letters that used to be drafted one by one now come out of a single batch about 5× faster, leaving HR staff more time for recruiting and working directly with employees. Feather was designed to grow into other repetitive HR and administrative tasks.
